title: Convert frmSplash to C#
problem_statement: The frmSplash form needs to be converted to a C# WinForms application while maintaining its startup behavior.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential loss of startup behavior and UI logic.
suggested_approach: Use a C# WinForms template to recreate the frmSplash form, ensuring all event handlers are properly mapped.
success_criteria: The C# form starts as expected and matches the legacy behavior.
